billingTimeEntry.title: Time Entry
billingTimeEntry.summary: An approved billable hour record dispatched to Shillinq's Work-In-Progress ledger.
billingTimeEntry.description: Time entries record billable or non-billable work hours against a client, lead, or project. On approval (status: approved) the entry is dispatched, one-way, to Shillinq's billable WIP balance via OpenRegister's WebhookService. wipSyncStatus and wipSyncedAt record the outcome of that integration. This schema is defined here so the WIP integration can stand alone; capture (timer/grid) is owned by OpenRegister's time-tracker leaf per ADR-022 and remains backwards-compatible (the leaf's link tables are unaffected).

title.description: Short human-readable label for the time entry.
title.title: Title

description.description: Free-text description of the work performed.
description.title: Description

hours.description: Hours worked (decimal). Cast to float on dispatch.
hours.title: Hours

date.description: ISO 8601 date the work was performed.
date.title: Date

status.description: Time entry lifecycle status. Approval triggers WIP dispatch.
status.title: Status

billingCategory.description: UUID or slug of the billing category (e.g. declarabel, wbso, dba, intern).
billingCategory.title: Billing Category

lead.description: UUID of the related lead, if any.
lead.title: Lead

approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the approval transition.
approvedAt.title: Approved At

wipSyncStatus.description: Shillinq WIP sync state. Null for entries approved before the WIP integration was deployed.
wipSyncStatus.title: Wip Sync Status

wipSyncedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last successful WIP sync delivery.
wipSyncedAt.title: Wip Synced At

user.description: Nextcloud user UID (or imported identity) who performed the work. Distinct from approvedBy; required for per-person hour reporting and for migrated worklogs booked on behalf of others.
user.title: User

metadata.description: Declared catch-all for source-system fields and provenance keys (e.g. tempoWorklogId, jiraIssueKey, migratedAt). Declared explicitly so magic-table storage persists it.
metadata.title: Metadata
